# kcore_object_user (Resource)

RGW user (`kctl create object-user`). The secret is only returned at create time.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kcore_object_user" "app" {
  name  = "app"
  store = kcore_object_store.s3.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `store` (String)

### Read-Only

- `access_key` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive)
